summary.zh: 评估发布就绪度，按渠道排出分阶段计划
summary.en: Score launch readiness and build a phased plan

description.zh: 为产品或功能发布做就绪度评估，并按渠道给出分阶段执行计划，覆盖预热、首发和后续跟进。适合临近上线、筹备 Product Hunt 首发、内测或等待名单时使用。
description.en: Assesses launch readiness and lays out a phased, per-channel plan covering warm-up, launch day and follow-through. Use it ahead of a release, a Product Hunt day, a beta or a waitlist.
